fr.sorbonne_u.components.endpoints

Class BCMEndPoint<CI extends RequiredCI>

  • java.lang.Object
    • fr.sorbonne_u.components.AbstractEndPoint
      • fr.sorbonne_u.components.endpoints.EndPoint<CI>
        • fr.sorbonne_u.components.endpoints.BCMEndPoint<CI>
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    AbstractEndPointI, BCMEndPointI<CI>, EndPointI<CI>, java.io.Serializable, java.lang.Cloneable
    Direct Known Subclasses:
    MultipleURIServiceEndpoint, SingleURIServiceEndpoint, URIServiceEndPoint

    public abstract class BCMEndPoint<CI extends RequiredCI>
extends EndPoint<CI>
implements BCMEndPointI<CI>, java.lang.Cloneable
    The class BCMEndPoint partially implements an end point that uses a BCM connection (outbound port -- connector -- inbound port); must be extended by actual end points on precise required/offered component interfaces.

    Description

    This class implement the BCM4Java protocol for connecting components through outbound ports, connectors and inbound ports. It is an abstract class because it requires subclasses to provide a way to create the outbound and inbound ports as well as the connector used to connect them. The user of this class must first define the classes implementing the ports and the connector. Then, he/she must define a subclass implementing the makeOutboundPort(AbstractComponent,String) and makeInboundPort(AbstractComponent,String) methods. In the BCM4Java approach, makeInboundPort() creates the inbound port with the provided URI on the given server component and publishes the port in the registry. makeOutboundPort(AbstractComponent,String) creates the outbound port on the given client component and then connects this port to the server component with the given inbound port URI using the appropriate connector.

    This partial implementation is not thread safe.

    Implementation Invariants

     invariant       serverSideOfferedInterface != null
 invariant       inboundPortURI != null && !inboundPortURI.isEmpty()
 invariant       serverSideInitialised() || inboundPort == null
 invariant       clientSideInitialised() || outboundPort == null

    Invariants

     invariant       true        // no more invariant

      • copyWithSharable

        public BCMEndPointI<CI> copyWithSharable()
        return a copy of this BCM end point with only the sharable information.

        Description

        In a BCMEndPoint, the following elements are considered as sharable:

        • the inherited sharable elements;
        • the component interface offered by the server side of the end point;
        • the URI of the inbound port offering the above component interface.

        By default, this implementation clone (i.e., shallow copy) the end point and nullify the non sharable elements. If a subclass introduces more non sharable elements, it will have to redefine the method to avoid copying these.

        Contract

         pre     true        // no more preconditions.
 post    return != null
 post    return.getClientSideInterface().equals(getClientSideInterface())
 post    return.getInboundPortURI().equals(getInboundPortURI())
 post    return.getServerSideInterface().equals(getServerSideInterface())
        Specified by:
        copyWithSharable in interface BCMEndPointI<CI extends RequiredCI>
        Specified by:
        copyWithSharable in interface EndPointI<CI extends RequiredCI>
        Returns:
        a duplicate of this end point except its transient information.
        See Also:
        BCMEndPointI.copyWithSharable()
